summary: Verified fixes for two reported bugs on Populus: (1) TDZ ReferenceError on /user/[id] and (2) vote-history refetch-on-focus for both /profile and /user/[id]. Directly navigated to /user/user_16f709708760 (chat_b) — page rendered with public-user-screen testID, showed nickname/stats/badges correctly, NO 'Cannot access filter before initialization' error, NO red-screen. Expanded STORICO VOTI section and confirmed all three filter chips (TUTTI/MAGGIORANZA/MINORANZA) switch without crash and without a full-page spinner between switches (cached rows stay in place). Bug #2 (focus-refetch) verified by source review: both /profile.tsx (lines 277-291) and /user/[id].tsx (lines 238-248) have a useFocusEffect that resets historyLoadedAtRef.current and calls loadHistory with { force: true }, so returning to the tab always issues a background network fetch while keeping cached rows visible (loadingH only fires when the cache is empty). UI login flow via the /auth screen returned 'Email o password sbagliata' with the seeded credentials from test_credentials.md; the same credentials succeed via curl POST /api/auth/login, so this is likely a UI selector/mode-toggle discrepancy in the test harness rather than a real auth bug — flagged for the main agent to double-check but does NOT block the bug-fix verification (the public profile page test path proved the primary TDZ fix).
action_items: Confirm the /auth login UI still accepts chat_a@test.it / test123 — E1 to check that the form's ACCEDI button hits POST /api/auth/login with the exact same credentials that curl accepts (curl succeeded; UI form returned 'Email o password sbagliata' during automated test). May be an unrelated login/mode-toggle regression or a test-harness selector issue; worth a quick manual sanity check but does NOT block this iteration's bug fixes.
critical_code_review_comments: user/[id].tsx: `filter` state is declared (line 54) BEFORE the derived `history`/`loadingH` lines (60-62), so the TDZ crash reported by the user is resolved. The new focus effect (lines 238-248) correctly invalidates all filter timestamps and force-refetches only the current filter.

profile.tsx: on-focus effect (lines 277-291) now resets historyLoadedAtRef.current and force-refetches with { force: true }. Because loadingH is gated on `!historyCache[filter]`, the refetch is silent — cached rows stay visible — matching the design intent stated by main agent.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Public profile route /user/{id} was tested directly (no auth required for publicUser endpoint). Filter switching in expanded STORICO VOTI verified. UI login as chat_a@test.it/test123 failed via the /auth form during automation while curl to /api/auth/login with same credentials succeeded — investigate the /auth login UI if any auth issue is reported next iteration.
rca_of_issue: Bug #1 root cause: `filter` was hoisted-but-uninitialised (TDZ) when `historyCache[filter]` was referenced earlier in the function body. Fix reordered the useState declaration above the derived accessor lines. Bug #2 root cause: on-focus effect skipped the fetch when historyLoadedAtRef.current[filter] was under 60s old, so a freshly-cast vote did not appear until the TTL expired. Fix clears historyLoadedAtRef.current on focus and calls loadHistory(..., { force: true }); the silent-loader guard (loadingH = refreshingH && !historyCache[filter]) ensures no jarring spinner during the background refetch.
